scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.zip: powershell Compress-Archive -Path allure-report -DestinationPath vc-studio-allure-report.zip -Force && echo 'Zipped to vc-studio-allure-report.zip'
scripts.deploy: npm run allure:generate && npx gh-pages -d allure-report -m "Deploy Allure report"
